column1: home|/hoʊm/|n. adv.|家；在家；回家|基础|independent|at home::在家;go home::回家|We usually have dinner together at home.::我们通常一起在家吃晚饭。|She felt at home in the quiet village.::她在这个安静的村庄里感到自在。

family|/ˈfæməli/|n.|家庭；家人|基础|independent|a family member::家庭成员;family life::家庭生活|Every family member helped prepare the meal.::每位家庭成员都帮忙准备了饭菜。|The new schedule gives him more time for family life.::新的日程让他有更多时间陪伴家人。
friend|/frend/|n.|朋友；友人|基础|friend|make friends::交朋友;a close friend::亲密的朋友|I made a new friend on the journey.::我在旅途中交了一位新朋友。|A close friend can help you through difficult times.::亲密的朋友可以帮助你度过困难时光。

friendship|/ˈfrendʃɪp/|n.|友谊；友情|基础|friend|build a friendship::建立友谊;a lasting friendship::长久的友谊|Their friendship began when they were children.::他们的友谊始于童年。|Honesty is important in a lasting friendship.::诚实对长久的友谊很重要。
help|/help/|v. n.|帮助；援助|基础|help|help someone with::在某方面帮助某人;ask for help::寻求帮助|Could you help me with this heavy box?::你能帮我搬一下这个重箱子吗？|There is nothing wrong with asking for help.::寻求帮助没有什么不妥。

helpful|/ˈhelpfəl/|adj.|有帮助的；乐于助人的|基础|help|helpful advice::有用的建议;be helpful to::对某人有帮助|The librarian gave us some helpful advice.::图书管理员给了我们一些有用的建议。|A simple map would be helpful to new visitors.::一张简单的地图会对初次来访者有帮助。
care|/ker/|n. v.|照料；关心；在意|基础|care|take care of::照顾;care about::关心|She takes care of her younger brother after school.::放学后她照顾弟弟。|We care about the quality of our work.::我们在意自己工作的质量。
careful|/ˈkerfəl/|adj.|小心的；认真的|基础|care|be careful with::小心处理;careful planning::周密计划|Be careful with the glass near the edge.::小心桌边的玻璃杯。|Careful planning helped us finish on time.::周密的计划帮助我们按时完成任务。
trust|/trʌst/|n. v.|信任；相信|基础|trust|build trust::建立信任;trust someone to do::相信某人会做某事|It takes time to build trust in a team.::在团队中建立信任需要时间。|I trust her to make a fair decision.::我相信她会作出公正的决定。

trustworthy|/ˈtrʌstwɜːrði/|adj.|值得信赖的；可靠的|扩展|trust|a trustworthy person::值得信赖的人;a trustworthy source::可靠的来源|We need information from a trustworthy source.::我们需要来自可靠来源的信息。|She proved to be a trustworthy partner.::事实证明她是一位值得信赖的合作伙伴。
believe|/bɪˈliːv/|v.|相信；认为|基础|believe|believe in::信任；相信某种价值;believe that::相信|I believe that we can find a solution.::我相信我们能找到解决办法。|Her parents always believed in her ability.::她的父母一直相信她的能力。

belief|/bɪˈliːf/|n.|信念；看法|基础|believe|a strong belief::坚定的信念;the belief that::某种看法|His belief in the project never changed.::他对这个项目的信念从未改变。|We should respect people with different beliefs.::我们应该尊重持有不同信念的人。

credible|/ˈkredəbəl/|adj.|可信的；可靠的|扩展|cred|a credible explanation::可信的解释;credible evidence::可靠的证据|The report needs more credible evidence.::这份报告需要更多可靠的证据。|Her account of the event seems credible.::她对这件事的叙述似乎可信。

incredible|/ɪnˈkredəbəl/|adj.|难以置信的；极好的|六级|cred|an incredible story::难以置信的故事;an incredible view::极美的景色|The view from the mountain was incredible.::山顶的景色美得令人惊叹。|He told us an incredible story about his journey.::他给我们讲了一个难以置信的旅行故事。

credit|/ˈkredɪt/|n. v.|信用；功劳；学分；归功于|基础|cred|give credit to::将功劳归于;earn credits::修得学分|Give credit to everyone who helped the project.::应该肯定所有帮助过这个项目的人。|Students can earn credits through practical training.::学生可以通过实践培训获得学分。

create|/kriˈeɪt/|v.|创造；创建；引起|基础|create|create an opportunity::创造机会;create a space::创造空间|The new park will create a space for everyone.::新公园将为所有人创造一个公共空间。|Small changes can create new opportunities.::小改变能够创造新机会。

creative|/kriˈeɪtɪv/|adj.|有创造力的；创造性的|四级|create|creative thinking::创造性思维;a creative solution::有创意的解决办法|The task encourages creative thinking.::这项任务鼓励创造性思维。|We need a creative solution to this problem.::我们需要一个有创意的办法来解决这个问题。

creativity|/ˌkriːeɪˈtɪvəti/|n.|创造力；创造性|扩展|create|encourage creativity::鼓励创造力;artistic creativity::艺术创造力|The workshop gives children room for creativity.::这个工作坊给孩子们发挥创造力的空间。|Creativity often grows through curiosity and practice.::创造力常在好奇与实践中发展。

connect|/kəˈnekt/|v.|连接；联系|基础|connect|connect with::与某人建立联系;connect to::连接到|The new bridge connects the two villages.::这座新桥连接了两个村庄。|Reading helps us connect with other people's experiences.::阅读帮助我们理解和联结他人的经历。

connection|/kəˈnekʃən/|n.|连接；联系；关联|基础|connect|a close connection::密切联系;an internet connection::互联网连接|There is a close connection between sleep and memory.::睡眠与记忆之间有密切联系。|Our internet connection was interrupted by the storm.::我们的网络连接被暴风雨中断了。

support|/səˈpɔːrt/|v. n.|支持；支撑；援助|基础|port|support a decision::支持决定;give support::提供支持|My family supported my decision to study abroad.::我的家人支持我出国学习的决定。|The old bridge can no longer support heavy vehicles.::这座旧桥已无法承受重型车辆。
comfort|/ˈkʌmfərt/|n. v.|安慰；舒适；使宽慰|基础|comfort|offer comfort::给予安慰;in comfort::舒适地|Her kind words gave me great comfort.::她亲切的话语给了我很大安慰。|They traveled in comfort on the new train.::他们乘坐新列车舒适地旅行。

comfortable|/ˈkʌmftərbəl/|adj.|舒适的；自在的|基础|comfort|feel comfortable::感到自在;a comfortable chair::舒适的椅子|Please choose a chair that feels comfortable.::请选一把坐着舒适的椅子。|She soon felt comfortable in the new class.::她很快在新班级里感到自在了。

patient|/ˈpeɪʃənt/|adj. n.|有耐心的；病人|基础|patient|be patient with::对某人有耐心;a hospital patient::住院病人|Please be patient with people who are still learning.::请对仍在学习的人多些耐心。|The patient was able to return home on Friday.::这位病人周五得以回家。
patience|/ˈpeɪʃəns/|n.|耐心；耐性|基础|patient|have patience::有耐心;lose patience::失去耐心|Learning a new skill requires patience.::学习一项新技能需要耐心。|Thank you for your patience during the delay.::谢谢你在延迟期间耐心等待。
adapt|/əˈdæpt/|v.|适应；改编；调整|基础|adapt|adapt to::适应;adapt a story::改编故事|It took time to adapt to the new schedule.::适应新的日程安排花了一些时间。|The director adapted the story for the stage.::导演把这个故事改编成了舞台剧。

adaptation|/ˌædæpˈteɪʃən/|n.|适应；改编作品|基础|adapt|adaptation to::对某事的适应;a film adaptation::电影改编作品|Adaptation to a new environment can be gradual.::适应新环境可能是一个渐进过程。|We watched a film adaptation of the novel.::我们观看了这部小说的电影改编版。

flexible|/ˈfleksəbəl/|adj.|灵活的；可弯曲的|基础|flex|flexible working hours::弹性工作时间;a flexible approach::灵活的方法|The company offers flexible working hours.::这家公司提供弹性工作时间。|A flexible approach helps us respond to change.::灵活的方法有助于我们应对变化。

flexibility|/ˌfleksəˈbɪləti/|n.|灵活性；柔韧性|扩展|flex|greater flexibility::更大的灵活性;improve flexibility::改善柔韧性|The plan allows greater flexibility in choosing courses.::这个计划让选课有更大的灵活性。|Regular stretching may improve your flexibility.::经常拉伸可能改善身体柔韧性。

balance|/ˈbæləns/|n. v.|平衡；使均衡；余额|基础|independent|keep one's balance::保持平衡;balance work and life::平衡工作与生活|She held the rail to keep her balance.::她扶住栏杆来保持平衡。|We are trying to balance work and family life.::我们正在努力平衡工作与家庭生活。
